name: Tammy Saulsbury
occupation: Natrona County assessor (re-elected November 2026). Oil City News reported that she said she started at the front desk in 2006 and was seeking her second term.
prior_offices: Natrona County assessor (won the November 2022 general election, defeating Matt Keating, and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Tammy Saulsbury is the Natrona County assessor and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. Oil City News reported that at a July 8, 2026, Politics in the Park forum she said she started working the front desk in 2006 and was seeking her second term, and that she defeated former assessor Matt Keating in the 2022 election.
